key.name: position
key.description: Banner in Quick Settings (top/bottom, attached or detached), or standalone panel button that opens the image on its own

key.name: gap
key.description: Gap in pixels when in detached mode

key.name: rounded-corners
key.description: Round the corners of the image (and the detached frame)

key.name: quick-settings-width
key.description: Width of the Quick Settings menu in pixels (0 = default)

key.name: image-path
key.description: Full path to the image file to display

key.name: hover-images-enabled
key.description: Enable multiple images that change on mouse hover

key.name: hover-images
key.description: Comma-separated list of image paths for hover effect

key.name: image-width
key.description: Width of the displayed image in pixels (-1 = full width: Quick Settings width, or screen width in standalone mode)

key.name: image-height
key.description: Height of the banner in pixels

key.name: panel-button-icon
key.description: Icon name or full path to an image file (standalone mode)

key.name: panel-button-position
key.description: Which side of the top panel the standalone button goes to

key.name: script-path
key.description: Path to script that executes when image is clicked
